name: Atlas V 401
note: Launched the real orbiter. A tight fit for a heavy design.
real: Launched both LRO and MRO (JPL MRO press kit: about $90M launch cost for MRO). Capacities and prices for other destinations are simplified game values.

name: Vulcan Centaur
note: More lift and margin, at a higher price.
real: 27,200 kg to low Earth orbit (NASA LSP fact sheet). Mars capacity and price here are simplified game values.

name: Falcon Heavy
note: Huge margin, but the price can break the budget.
real: Nearly 64 t to orbit (NASA LSP fact sheet); launched Europa Clipper. Capacities to each destination and prices are simplified game values.
